subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. D sits second to the left of B. E sits second to the right of F. C is on the immediate right of D. Who is sitting on the immediate left of A?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

D sits second to the left of B.

E sits second to the right of F.

C is on the immediate right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/582f7554fb4d227b1e20076dc2dbdaf73e57061eb69b770acd343e4280a65891.png] 

Here, F is sitting on the immediate left of A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
